v: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the midst of your temple.
b: This verse reminds us that thinking on God’s lovingkindness in His temple is an important part of our life of worship. When we focus on God’s lovingkindness, our souls are renewed and our faith increases. This thinking does not stay merely in the mind but is the thanksgiving and meditation that wells up from deep within, a looking back on God’s grace with praise.

It is like an artist looking back over the course of his work, remembering the effort and love he put into each step. The more he is immersed in memory, the better he can appreciate the beauty of the work. In the same way, when we think on God’s lovingkindness, we see more of His works in our lives, and so we love Him and trust Him all the more.

There was a brother named Zhang Hongyu who, during one family worship, recalled with his family God’s graces over the past year. They mentioned how God had provided for their financial needs in hardship, how He had given healing in illness, and how He had brought reconciliation when relationships were strained. Hongyu said, “When we counted God’s graces together, we truly felt that He had been beside us all along and had never left.” This remembering made the whole family more thankful and more willing to entrust the future to God.

Hongyu’s story reminds us that when we stop and think on God’s lovingkindness, our hearts are filled with joy and peace. Even when we are going through challenges, recalling God’s works gives us strength to keep walking on the path of faith.

Dear family, let us remember that thinking on God’s lovingkindness is a form of worship toward Him. When we count His graces, our souls are watered and our lives renewed. May we learn, in our daily lives, to meditate on His lovingkindness and share this love with others.
a: Journal of Lovingkindness
Each day, record one way God has provided for, protected, or blessed you with lovingkindness, and look back through it regularly with thanks.
Thankful Worship
Set aside a time in worship to meditate on God’s lovingkindness, through song, prayer, or quiet meditation, focusing on His grace.
Family Review of Lovingkindness
With your family, look back over God’s works, count the graces your family has experienced, and pray with thanks for the future.
Sharing Grace
Share with friends or your fellowship an experience in which you especially sensed God’s lovingkindness, to be an encouragement to them.
Bible Meditation
Choose a psalm to read (such as Psalm 48 or 103), think carefully about its descriptions of God’s lovingkindness, and write down what you receive.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your endless lovingkindness that surrounds us every day. Help us to think on Your grace in worship, so that our lives are filled with hope and gratitude by Your love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you think more on God’s lovingkindness in your worship every day, and answer His grace with a thankful heart and with faith. Amen!

v: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
b: This verse reminds us that, whatever difficulty we face, God’s strength and lovingkindness are our comfort and assurance. When we praise God in song, especially in the early morning, our hearts are filled with His lovingkindness as the new day begins. We sing of His strength because He has been our protector in times of distress; we sing aloud of His lovingkindness because He has not only led us through the valley but also let us find our support in His grace.

It is like a mother who, whatever danger her child meets, wraps her arms around the child to protect him from harm. In the same way, in our distress God protects us with His great power and comforts us with lovingkindness, becoming our high tower and our refuge.

There was a sister named Lin Yaqi who, while studying abroad, went through a serious financial crisis and felt desperate for lack of tuition and living expenses. In prayer she committed her worries to God and praised His faithfulness and lovingkindness in song. A week later she received an anonymous donation that was exactly enough to pay her tuition, enabling her to finish her studies. Yaqi said, “When I chose to sing aloud of God’s lovingkindness, my heart was filled with strength and peace. I knew that God is my refuge and will never leave me.”

Yaqi’s testimony reminds us that, whatever distress we face, God’s lovingkindness has never left us. When we lift up His name in song, our souls are renewed by His strength and comforted by His lovingkindness.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s strength is our high tower and His lovingkindness is our refuge. May we greet each new day every morning with thanks and song, and in difficulty always rely on His lovingkindness and power.
a: Morning Praise Time
Each morning, spend five minutes praising God’s lovingkindness and strength with a hymn or a prayer, letting His grace fill the new day.
Share a Testimony
At a family gathering or in a small group, share an experience of God’s protection or provision, encouraging others also to trust in His lovingkindness.
Build a Notebook of Faith
Record how you overcame past difficulties by relying on God and how He became your refuge, and look through it at any time to strengthen your faith.
Time of Musical Worship
Choose some songs on the theme of God’s lovingkindness, such as “The LORD Is My Refuge,” and sing of God’s lovingkindness together with family or fellowship.
Plan for Prayer in Distress
When you face a challenge, build a habit of prayer, commit the difficulty to God, and comfort yourself and others with His word and with songs.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being our refuge in distress and supporting us with lovingkindness and great power. Help us to greet each new day with praise and to learn to trust You completely in difficulty. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sing wholeheartedly of God’s strength and lovingkindness in every day of your life, and enjoy peace and joy under His protection. Amen!

v: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
b: This verse is the psalmist’s plea, and it is also the longing of each of us: to see God’s lovingkindness and to experience the salvation He gives. When we see God’s lovingkindness, our lives are no longer dry but full of hope; when we receive His salvation, our souls no longer drift but find rest and belonging.

Just as a long-parched field longs for rain, God’s lovingkindness is the watering of our souls, and salvation is our spring. When we turn to Him, He answers our need with His boundless grace and mercy and gives us the fullness of life.

There was a sister named Zhao Sihan whose spirit had been weary for years because of strained family relationships. Once she attended an evangelistic meeting at church where the pastor, speaking of God’s lovingkindness, said, “God not only sees your difficulty, He is willing to change your life with His salvation.” Sihan’s heart was touched, and that day she decided to accept the Lord. Afterward, her life of prayer and Bible reading gradually let her sense the reality of God’s lovingkindness. She not only learned to forgive and accept her family but also became a peacemaker in the family, leading them to reconciliation. Sihan later said, “When I saw God’s lovingkindness, my heart grew tender and my life was completely renewed.”

Sihan’s experience reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is not only our comfort but also the power that changes our lives. When we open ourselves to Him, His salvation enters our lives and gives us true peace and fulfillment.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness can be seen at any time and His salvation received at any time. When we call on Him, He will answer our hearts’ desire with endless grace.
a: Journal of Grace
Each day, record one experience of God’s lovingkindness and salvation, to remind yourself of His presence and blessing.
Sharing Testimonies of Lovingkindness
Share with family or friends how you have seen God’s lovingkindness, inspiring them also to experience His grace.
Prayer Cards of Lovingkindness
Make a card filled with encouraging Scripture and give it to someone in need, so that they feel God’s love.
Acts of Loving Greeting
Take the initiative to greet neighbors or coworkers, care about their needs, and pass on God’s lovingkindness through practical action.
Devotional Meditation Time
Spend fifteen minutes each day meditating on God’s lovingkindness, repeat Psalm 85:7 quietly, and ask God to reveal His salvation.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing us Your lovingkindness and giving us salvation to be our strength and hope. Help us to see Your lovingkindness every day and to find rest in Your salvation. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see God’s lovingkindness every day, experience His salvation, and enjoy peace and abundance in His presence. Amen!

v: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
b: This verse is full of joy and thanksgiving, reminding us that God’s lovingkindness is endless and worth praising and proclaiming for a whole lifetime. Not only that, His faithfulness is shown throughout the generations, bringing us unchanging comfort and hope. When we sing of His lovingkindness with our mouths, not only are we satisfied, but those around us are encouraged and long for God’s love.

It is like a lilting song: as the melody flows and touches the depths of the heart, it brings comfort to the singer and also moves the listeners, bringing hope and strength. In the same way, our praise of God’s lovingkindness is like a moving piece of music that lets people feel heavenly love and peace.

There was a sister named Ye Xinrou who was a music teacher and had once felt lost because of financial pressure and family problems. By chance she attended a musical worship service at church, where the hymn sang, “The Lord’s lovingkindness never ceases, His faithfulness lasts forever.” These words touched her heart deeply, and she began to use music to record God’s lovingkindness and grace in her life. Gradually Xinrou’s life became rich, and her teaching, too, was filled with love and patience because of this faith. Today she often leads her students in praising God’s lovingkindness with music, bearing witness to His grace in song.

Xinrou’s story reminds us that singing of God’s lovingkindness is not only a way of expressing thanks but also a way of sharing our faith. Whether or not our voice is moving, when we praise God’s lovingkindness with a sincere heart, His name is lifted up, and His love can influence more people through us.
Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is worth singing and proclaiming all our lives. As we speak of His faithfulness with our mouths, our lives too become a witness to His glory.
a: A Time of Worship
Worship God with a hymn each day. Choose a song that praises His lovingkindness and let your heart be joined to God.
Journal of Thanks
Record each day God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness in your life, and share how you feel at family gatherings.
Melody of Love
Learn a worship song that touches your heart and share it with friends or lead it in a small group.
Visiting with Song
Visit the elderly or the sick with brothers and sisters from church, sharing God’s love and faithfulness through song and testimony.
Blessing Cards of Lovingkindness
Write a passage of Scripture about God’s lovingkindness and give it to a friend in need, encouraging them to look to God’s grace.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us lovingkindness and faithfulness, which fill our lives with hope. Help us to sing of Your lovingkindness from the heart and to witness to Your faithfulness with our lives. May our voices be Your glory and inspire more people to know You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sing aloud of God’s lovingkindness every day, and proclaim His faithfulness with your life, becoming a blessing and a light in people’s hearts. Amen!

v: With the ten-stringed lute and the harp, with the melody of the lyre, to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night. It is a good thing.
b: This verse reminds us that proclaiming God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness is a very beautiful thing. Whether with instruments, with song, or with the testimony of our lives, we can become carriers of His love. Worship in the morning and in the evening symbolizes that each of our days should begin with God’s lovingkindness and end with His faithfulness. Such a life will be full of hope and gratitude.

Like a farmer who sows seed in the fields every morning and watches carefully over their growth in the evening, so is our life. When we sow a testimony of God’s lovingkindness with a thankful heart, we will see the fruit of love and faithfulness in our lives continue to grow.

There was a brother named Zhang Jianhua who was a retired musician and often organized musical gatherings in the community. He would play worship hymns on the cello and share with people how God had shown His lovingkindness in his life. Once, his neighbor, Grandma Li, fell into grief after losing her husband, and Jianhua kept her company with music and warm words and also invited her to the gatherings. While he was playing “Amazing Grace,” Grandma Li shed tears and said she felt a peace and comfort she had never known before. Later she also accepted the gospel and became a zealous Christian.

Jianhua’s testimony reminds us that proclaiming God’s lovingkindness does not necessarily require a grand stage or any one particular method. If we are willing, God will use our gifts and our lives to pass His lovingkindness on to those around us.

Dear family, let us remember that proclaiming God’s lovingkindness is the mission of our lives. Whether through music, writing, or words and deeds, we can all be messengers of His love and witnesses to His glory.
a: Music Testimony
Choose the worship song that moves you most, and share God’s lovingkindness with those around you through singing or an instrument.
Daily Proclamation
In the morning, write a sentence thanking God for His lovingkindness; in the evening, review the day’s graces and share them with your family or small group.
The Gospel in Action
Care for those near you who are in need through practical action, such as bringing a simple breakfast or a warm word, so that they feel God’s love.
Hymn Fellowship
Organize a small-group hymn-sharing gathering, inviting everyone to witness to God’s lovingkindness through song and encourage one another’s faith.
Sharing on Social Media
Share a verse or your testimony on social platforms, so that more people know how real and good God’s lovingkindness is.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the opportunity to proclaim Your lovingkindness and faithfulness with our lives. Help us each day to witness to Your goodness with thankful hearts and to share this grace with more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you proclaim God’s lovingkindness in all kinds of ways every day, so that more people, through your testimony, sense His grace and peace. Amen!

v: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness exists not only in good times but is also shown in our suffering and hardship. He is not far from our pain; He is with us, understands our struggles, and accompanies us through the valley with His boundless lovingkindness. When we respond to His lovingkindness with thankful hearts, difficulty becomes an opportunity for growth and joy.

It is like a mother who, when she sees her child fall, goes over at once to lift him up and soothe his pain. The child may cry, but the mother’s love gives his heart comfort again. God’s lovingkindness is like this too: He knows our hurts and comforts us with warm love so that we can stand firm again.

There was a brother named Lin Zhihao who went through one blow after another in his career and family. He lost his steady job, and his mother also fell ill and was hospitalized in that time, leaving him exhausted in body and mind. Just when he had almost lost faith, he sensed God’s lovingkindness in prayer. Zhihao said, “I know God has not left me. He has been with me all along.” After that, every day he thanked God for the blessings he still had, such as a healthy body and the company of his family. Slowly he found a new job, and the family’s hardships were gradually overcome. He believes deeply that it was God’s lovingkindness that held up his life and brought him out of the darkest days.

Zhihao’s story reminds us that when our hearts are full of hardship, we should remember that God has already seen it and holds us up with His lovingkindness. He understands all our struggles, opens a way for us, and brings peace and joy.
Dear family, let us remember that, whatever challenges we meet, God’s lovingkindness is always with us. He sees our affliction, understands our struggles, and leads us out of the gloom by His grace.
a: List of Thanks
Each day, record three things that make you sense God’s lovingkindness, and give thanks to God even for small details.
Comfort Others
Find a friend going through a hard time, keep them company, and encourage them with God’s word and your testimony.
Revisit an Experience
Look back on a difficulty in your past, write down how God upheld and helped you then, and share this experience with your group or family.
Acts of Lovingkindness
Take the initiative to help someone in need, for example by visiting or giving a gift, and let God’s lovingkindness flow out through you.
Daily Prayer
Tell God your troubles in prayer, thank Him for His presence, and commit your burdens to Him.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for seeing our affliction and understanding our hardship. Your lovingkindness gives us strength and lets us rejoice in difficulty. Help us always to remember Your presence and to answer Your grace with thankful hearts. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be glad in God’s lovingkindness in times of affliction, and find peace and strength in His presence. Amen!

v: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
b: This verse shows us two choices in life: the wicked, who choose to stay away from God, experience sorrow because of their own conduct; while those who choose to trust in Yahweh find protection on every side in His lovingkindness. God’s lovingkindness is not a temporary shelter but an all-round companionship that surrounds us, so that in His grace we fear no challenge from our environment.

It is like a shepherd who watches over each sheep carefully and surrounds the flock with a sturdy fence to keep out outside threats. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is like this fence, surrounding us on every side, so that we not only have safety but also enjoy His provision and comfort.

There was a sister named Chen Meilian who lost the family’s main source of income in an accident, and her life fell into hardship. When all hope seemed shattered, she began to rely on God all the more, praying and reading the Bible every day and trusting that God’s lovingkindness would accompany her through these hard days. She experienced wonderful provision: relatives and friends offered help on their own, and brothers and sisters from church also brought food and financial support. She said, “God’s lovingkindness not only held me up but also surrounded me through the people around me.” In the end, by God’s grace Meilian rebuilt her family and took an active part in the church’s charitable ministry, becoming a blessing to others.

Meilian’s testimony reminds us that when we choose to trust in God, His lovingkindness is like a sturdy barrier that surrounds us on every side, protecting us and also bringing heavenly provision and joy.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is the most dependable support in our lives. When we trust in Him and seek His guidance, He will surely surround us with His endless lovingkindness and lead us through every step of life.
a: Daily Prayer of Trust
Each morning, pray over the day’s plans, asking God’s lovingkindness to surround you and guide your steps.
Acts of Care
Take the initiative to care for a friend going through hardship, and be an extension of God’s lovingkindness with practical help or encouraging words.
Testimony of Lovingkindness
Record a time when you personally experienced being surrounded by God’s lovingkindness, and share it with family or friends to strengthen one another’s faith.
Devotional Gathering
Attend a small group or church gathering, share testimonies of God’s lovingkindness with other believers, and pray together.
Thanksgiving Activity
Use a gratitude journal to write down each day the moments you sensed God’s lovingkindness, to help you learn to trust in Him more.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for surrounding us on every side with lovingkindness, protecting us and supplying all our needs. Help us to rely on You more in difficulty and to witness to Your grace with our lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s surrounding lovingkindness every day, and, whatever your circumstances, find comfort and strength in His grace. Amen!

v: Let your loving kindnesses also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s word is the foundation of His lovingkindness, and that His lovingkindness always goes hand in hand with His salvation. When we call on God for His lovingkindness, we acknowledge our need and long for God Himself to come and fill our lives. His lovingkindness is not an abstract idea but His actual act of saving us, giving through His word everything we need.

It is like a doctor who not only writes the right prescription but also brings the medicine himself and patiently instructs the patient on how to recover. In the same way, God’s word is like the prescription, and His lovingkindness is the medicine that heals the wounds of our hearts. When we call on Him, He will, according to His promise, bring salvation upon us, giving us strength in difficulty and guidance when we are lost.

There was a sister named Lin Peiru who sensed the coming of God’s lovingkindness at the lowest point of her life. She had lost her job unexpectedly, fell into depression, and even lost confidence in the future. Once, in her devotions, she read this verse, a longing rose in her heart, and she prayed to God, “Lord, according to Your word, let Your lovingkindness come upon me.” A few days later a friend invited her to a lecture on her own initiative. The lecture not only helped her recognize her own worth but also rekindled her hope for life. Peiru gradually regained her spirits and finally found a new job, which not only met her needs but also gave her the chance to help more people. She understood that God’s lovingkindness was bringing salvation into her life through His word and the people around her.

Peiru’s story reminds us that God’s lovingkindness always comes to us according to His promise. As long as we are willing to call on Him, His salvation will be like the morning sun, warming our cold hearts and bringing new hope.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s word is the way by which we receive His lovingkindness and salvation. When we focus on His promises and call on Him, His lovingkindness will surely come upon us, so that at every stage of life we can sense His grace and support.
a: Meditating on Promises
Each day, choose a verse of God’s promise, meditate on it and pray, asking God’s lovingkindness to come into your life.
Caring Intercession
Pray for a friend going through a low point and share God’s word with them, becoming a channel through which others experience God’s lovingkindness.
List of Thanks
List the things God has fulfilled according to His promises in the past, to help you sense His lovingkindness and salvation more deeply.
Creative Sharing
Record this verse in calligraphy, painting, or music, and share it with those around you, passing on the message of God’s lovingkindness.
Acts of Love
Offer practical support to someone near you who needs help, letting God’s lovingkindness become a blessing to others through your hands.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for bringing Your lovingkindness and salvation into our lives through Your word. Help us to look to You more each day and to be witnesses of Your lovingkindness, passing Your love on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience the coming of God’s lovingkindness in your daily life, and find peace and fulfillment in His salvation. Amen!

v: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;
b: This verse is God’s renewed promise to David, showing the father-and-son relationship between God and His chosen one and revealing His never-forsaking lovingkindness toward His people. Even when people fail in weakness, God’s lovingkindness continues. He does not lightly take His lovingkindness away, because His love is based not only on our conduct but also on His choosing of us and His promise.

It is like a parent’s love for a child: however great the child’s mistake, the parents will always hope he mends his ways and will win him back with continuing love. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is constant and unchanging. He wins us back with grace and firmly promises that He will not let His lovingkindness leave us.

There was a brother named Zhang Guoxiang who had once drifted from God in his faith. In pursuit of worldly success he neglected his devotions and church life, and even got involved in improper business dealings. When the matter came to light, he lost his business, and even his family lost trust in him. He felt extreme shame and despair. Yet at his most helpless moment, he opened the Bible again and read the promise that God would not take His lovingkindness away. He felt deeply that God was still waiting for his repentance, so he knelt and wept in prayer, confessing his sin to God and seeking His mercy. Surprisingly, God restored his life step by step, giving him new opportunities and strength. His family, too, because of his change, accepted him again.

Guoxiang’s testimony tells us that God’s lovingkindness will not leave us. Even if we have strayed from Him, as long as we are willing to turn back, He will embrace us with love and lead us out of the low points of life.

Dear family, let us remember that God surrounds us with eternal lovingkindness and does not lightly take His love away. Even if we are weak and fail, as long as we return to Him, His lovingkindness will fill our lives again and become our hope and strength.
a: Prayer of Returning
Each day, spend time praying to God, reflecting on whether there is any place where you have strayed from Him, and sincerely turn back to Him and receive His lovingkindness.
Passing On Love
With a phone call or a message, show care for a friend you have lost touch with, letting him feel God’s love flowing through your actions.
Practice Forgiveness
Take God’s lovingkindness as your example and forgive on your own initiative those who have offended you, sharing grace with them.
Promise Cards
Make an encouragement card with this verse on it and give it to someone who needs encouragement, reminding him that God’s lovingkindness will not leave him.
Spiritual Renewal
Set up a devotional plan for yourself, letting God’s word be your strength every day and helping you hold tightly to His lovingkindness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for surrounding us with lovingkindness that never forsakes us. Even when we are weak and wayward, You still wait for us to come back to Your embrace. Help us to hold on to Your promise and to be people who pass on lovingkindness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s unfailing lovingkindness every day, and find eternal peace and joy in His promises. Amen!

v: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
b: This verse shows the psalmist’s complete obedience to God and his witness. He not only keeps God’s righteousness and lovingkindness in his heart but also proclaims them openly in the great assembly. God’s lovingkindness and truth are not hidden. They should be our testimony every day, in private and in public alike, and we should boldly declare God’s faithfulness and love. This is a call, and also a challenge to every Christian: are we living out God’s lovingkindness in our lives, not concealing it but sharing it with others without reservation?

It is like a gardener who carefully cultivates every flower in his garden and shares its beauty and fragrance with the people around him. God’s lovingkindness is like the beautiful flowers in this garden. When we experience how good it is, we should display it without reservation, so that others too can sense God’s love and grace.

There was a sister named Li Ting who was a nurse and often faced the pain and anxiety of patients and their families. While helping a seriously ill patient, she decided to treat each patient with God’s lovingkindness and not merely to provide medical service. She prayed for patients at their bedsides and comforted them with warm words. One day a patient with cancer said to her, “I feel that everything you do is full of love and comfort, and it has taken away my fear of this illness.” Li Ting’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness should not be hidden but should be a natural outflow of our lives, and that, whenever and wherever, we should boldly express and share it.
Li Ting’s story tells us that when we live out God’s lovingkindness and truth, we can not only change others but also experience more abundance in God’s grace.

Dear family, let us remember that our lives should be a witness to God’s lovingkindness and truth. As we live every day in God’s grace, we should share this love with others without reservation, whether in the family, at work, or in the church.
a: Open Testimony
Share with friends or family the lovingkindness of God that you have experienced lately, bearing witness to His love through stories or personal experience.
Boldly Express Lovingkindness
Today, express your love and care to at least three people, whether in words, actions, or prayer, and let God’s lovingkindness flow through you.
Cards of Love
Write a card or message that sends God’s love and blessing to someone in need, encouraging them to rely on God in hard times.
Sharing Testimonies
In a church group or a family gathering, share God’s lovingkindness and grace in your life, so that others too can sense His reality and love.
Caring for Others
Take the initiative to care for those who are lonely or in difficulty, passing on God’s love and comfort by visiting, calling, or texting.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing Your lovingkindness and truth at every moment. Help us to boldly share Your love and grace with those around us in daily life, so that they too can experience Your truth and faithfulness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out God’s lovingkindness and truth every day, and boldly share His love with those around you, becoming a witness to His grace. Amen!

t: He Has Not Removed His Lovingkindness
v: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
b: This verse emphasizes God’s lasting lovingkindness in our lives: even in our prayers and needs, God never turns us away, and His lovingkindness is always with us. Even when we feel weary, confused, or lonely, God’s love never leaves us, and He always listens and answers our prayers. This is proof of His unchanging faithfulness and grace toward us.

It is like the waves that never stop beating against the shore: however the wind and waves change, the water always returns to the shore with unchanging power. God’s lovingkindness is like these waves. Whatever challenges and difficulties we meet, His love always surrounds us and never leaves.

There was a brother named Wang Yu who once went through a very hard time. His parents died one after the other within a single year, and he felt deep loss and helplessness. Yet in this painful process Wang Yu did not draw away from God but sought God’s face all the more earnestly. Whenever he knelt in prayer, he always felt a warmth and comfort, as if God’s lovingkindness were wrapping around him. Looking back on that time, he said with deep feeling, “Although I went through the hardest time of my life, God’s love never left me, and His lovingkindness carried me through those dark days.”

Wang Yu’s experience reminds us that, whatever difficulty we are in, God’s lovingkindness never leaves us. His love is not limited by time or circumstance. It always walks with us, giving us comfort and strength.

Dear family, let us remember that, whatever challenges we face, God’s lovingkindness always surrounds us and never leaves. We can trust Him with all our hearts, for His love does not change and is always our strength and comfort.
a: Meditating on Lovingkindness

Find a quiet place, breathe deeply, close your eyes, and meditate on the specific moments today when you sensed God’s lovingkindness. Whether facing difficulty or in ordinary daily life, remember that God’s lovingkindness is always with you. Take a few minutes to be still and feel the company of this love.
List of Thanks

List three things today for which you are thankful for God’s lovingkindness. Whether big or small, gratitude helps us focus more on God’s grace and lovingkindness. Make thankfulness a daily habit, write God’s lovingkindness on your heart, and share it with those around you.
List of Love

Make a “list of love” of three people you feel need God’s lovingkindness, and pray for them. Whether they are in difficulty or need encouragement, ask God’s lovingkindness to touch their lives. You can also bring God’s lovingkindness to them in simple words or actions.
Thank-You Cards

Prepare a few small cards with “God’s lovingkindness will never leave you” or other words of encouragement, and give them to people who are going through challenges or need encouragement. Through these small gestures, pass God’s lovingkindness on to others.
Daily Challenge of Lovingkindness

Today, challenge yourself to do at least three things without expecting anything in return, whether helping a coworker, caring for family, or helping a stranger. This is not only a response to God’s lovingkindness but also a way to practice God’s love in daily life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your unfailing lovingkindness. Your love is always our strength and comfort. Help us to experience Your lovingkindness every day and to pass this love on to others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s unfailing lovingkindness every day. In joy or in difficulty, His love is always with you, giving you peace and hope. Amen!

v: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.
b: This verse reminds us that, however life changes, God’s lovingkindness toward us never changes. Mountains may shift and weather may change, but God’s love is forever firm and steadfast, and His promises have never changed. This unconditional love means that, whatever our situation and whatever challenge we meet, God is beside us and never leaves.

It is like the roots of a great tree: through wind and rain, it remains firmly rooted in the ground, and whatever changes in the world outside, the roots never waver. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is like the foundation of that tree, firmly supporting our lives and keeping us steady in difficulty.

There was a sister named Li Mei whose life was full of challenges, with constant pressure at work and frequent conflicts at home. Once, her husband suddenly lost his job, which left her extremely uneasy. She wanted to give up and thought she could not bear any more. But at just that moment she opened the Bible and saw this verse, and she felt God’s comfort. She deeply understood that, however the world changes, God’s love remains the same, and He had never left her. This love lifted her up again, and she began to turn her focus to God and face the challenges of life with a thankful heart.

Li Mei’s testimony tells us that God’s lovingkindness is not an empty promise but powerful support, the strength that gets us through storms. Whatever challenge we face, we can rely on God’s unchanging love and keep walking firmly.

Dear family, let us remember that, whatever difficulty we face, God’s lovingkindness never changes. His covenant of peace is forever firm, and we can rely on Him completely, passing through every low point in life and finding peace and strength in His love.
a: Journal of Reviewing Lovingkindness

Take a few minutes to look back over the past week and write down three specific events in which God showed His lovingkindness, whether peace, protection, or care. This reminds us of the reality of God’s lovingkindness and encourages us to hold firmly to it in difficulty.
Thank-You Cards of Lovingkindness

Prepare three thank-you cards with the message “God’s lovingkindness will never leave me” and give them to people who need comfort, so that they too may experience God’s lovingkindness and encouragement.
Plan to Accompany with Lovingkindness
Find a family member or friend, whether in difficulty or in need of encouragement, and share with them God’s never-departing lovingkindness, letting God’s love flow in your relationship.
Daily Prayer and Reflection

Each morning, pray to God, thank Him for His unconditional lovingkindness, and extend this love through your whole day. Write down how you will show this love today, whether to family, coworkers, or strangers.
Family Time of Lovingkindness
Share with your family a story or experience in which you sensed God’s lovingkindness. This helps build trust with one another and lets God’s love flow in the home, encouraging one another.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You that Your lovingkindness, whatever difficulty we face, never leaves us and is with us. Help us to live out this unconditional love and to pass Your lovingkindness on to friends and family around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God’s lovingkindness never leave you, and, however your circumstances change, may His peace be with you forever. Amen!

t: Do Not Let Lovingkindness Leave You
v: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness and truth should be the foundation of our lives, and that at all times and in all places we should neither forget nor neglect these two important divine qualities. It tells us not only to live out these virtues but also to fix them firmly in our hearts, letting them be, at every moment, the guide of our conduct.

It is like a craftsman who, when making a work of art, carves every detail again and again to make sure each stroke is exact. God’s lovingkindness and truth are engraved on our hearts in just this way and become the guiding principles of our lives. When we root these virtues deeply in our hearts, our lives will line up more closely with God’s heart, and we will show His love and truth in our conduct.

There was a young man named Zhang Qi who had faced many temptations in life and, in seeking short-term gain, had neglected honesty and integrity. At that time he thought that, as long as he reached his goal, the means did not matter. Yet this choice gradually cost him his inner peace and distanced him from those around him. Then one day he heard this passage at church and suddenly realized that he had strayed far from God’s teaching. From then on Zhang Qi resolved that, whatever the situation, he would hold to the principles of lovingkindness and truth and make these qualities the foundation of his life. He began to learn to make honest choices at work and to respond to every challenge with love. In the end Zhang Qi not only regained his inner peace but also, through his honest and loving conduct, won the respect of those around him.

Zhang Qi’s testimony tells us that when we make God’s lovingkindness and truth the core of our lives, our lives become richer. We will not only experience God’s blessing but also become a blessing in the lives of others.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness and truth are indispensable parts of our lives. May we engrave these two virtues deeply on our hearts every day and let them guide our conduct, so that God’s love and truth are revealed in our lives.
a: Meditation on Lovingkindness and Truth
Take five minutes to meditate quietly on how God’s lovingkindness and truth show themselves in your life, and write down three ways you can apply these virtues more deeply in your daily life.
Commitment to Lovingkindness and Truth
Today, make a commitment to yourself to keep walking in God’s lovingkindness and truth through the coming day, at work or at home. This is not only honesty toward others but also a promise to God.
Thanks and Action

At the end of each day, note two blessings that came to you because you chose lovingkindness and truth. It might be someone’s response to you, or an inner peace. Let thankfulness become your daily habit.
Acts of Lovingkindness

Today, find someone who needs help, whether a coworker, friend, or stranger, and take the initiative to care for and help them, treating them with love and honesty. Remember that this is not only action but must be done with a sincere heart.
Honest Reflection

Each evening, compare your conduct of the day with what you intended and examine whether you have lived out lovingkindness and truth. If you have strayed, confess to God and ask for His help, so that His lovingkindness and truth take deeper root in your life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You that Your lovingkindness and truth never change and are our guide. Help us to live out Your love and truth every day and to show Your glory in all our conduct. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out God’s lovingkindness and truth every day, and experience His endless grace and blessing in your life. Amen!

v: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
b: This verse shows that God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness toward us are lasting and unchanging, and that He does not withdraw His love because of our faults. Even when we make mistakes and turn away from Him, God’s lovingkindness still surrounds us deeply, and His faithfulness never fails. Such love, unconditional and eternal, lets us rely on Him steadfastly whatever difficulty or challenge we face in life.

It is like a ship on the sea: however fierce the storm, the ship always drifts toward a safe harbor. God’s lovingkindness is like that ocean, which does not change because the waves surge. It always shelters us and guides us toward His comfort and protection.

There was a sister named Liu Meihua who had gone through a low point in life over the past few years. Because of some wrong choices, she once felt that God seemed to have distanced Himself from her, and she doubted whether God would forgive her faults. Yet in a quiet prayer, God let her receive this passage, and she deeply sensed that His lovingkindness had never left her. Although she had made mistakes, God’s love had been waiting for her to return. This brought her great comfort and encouraged her to stand up again and commit her life to God. From then on, Meihua no longer doubted God’s love but entrusted everything to Him and found peace and strength in His faithfulness.

Meihua’s story tells us that, however great our failures or mistakes, God’s love is never withdrawn. He is always beside us, waiting for us to return to His embrace. His faithfulness also lets us understand that He will not give up on us, and that wherever we are, His love will lead us toward restoration.

Dear family, let us remember that, whatever our situation, God’s lovingkindness will never be withdrawn and His faithfulness will never fail. May we rely deeply on this unchanging love in our daily lives, live it out, and pass it on to those around us.
a: Review God’s Lovingkindness and Faithfulness
Take five minutes to look back over your past life, write down three events in which you personally experienced God’s lovingkindness and faithfulness, and give thanks for His continued protection.
Forgive Others on Your Own Initiative
Look back on your recent relationships with others, and if there is any unreleased resentment, choose to forgive today and pass this lovingkindness on to others.
Acts of Lovingkindness
Today, find someone, whether a friend, family member, or stranger, and give them an act of love, whether an encouraging word or practical help, letting God’s love flow through you.
Evening List of Thanks
Each evening, write down how God showed His unchanging love today, and thank Him for His faithfulness and protection.
Start a Journal of Lovingkindness
Start a journal of lovingkindness, record each day the lovingkindness of God that you have experienced, and share these stories with those around you, bearing witness to His love.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your lovingkindness and faithfulness, which are never withdrawn. Your love fills our lives and is our firm support. Help us in every day of our lives to live out Your love and truth and to pass this love on to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s ever-expanding lovingkindness every day, and find eternal assurance and hope in His faithfulness. Amen!

v: Do they not go astray who devise evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who devise good.
b: This verse tells us that when we choose to do good and seek uprightness and honesty in our hearts, God’s lovingkindness will follow. On the other hand, those who devise evil in their hearts will go astray and in the end be unable to receive God’s blessing. God’s lovingkindness and truth are closely tied to a heart that chooses to do good, and when we choose good deeds we will experience God’s boundless lovingkindness and true faithfulness.

It is like a fruit tree: when we till, fertilize, and water it with care, the tree will bear abundant fruit. In the same way, when we choose to devise good and act righteously, God’s lovingkindness and truth will, like gentle rain, water the field of our hearts and let our lives bear fruit that belongs to God.

There was a brother named Li Ming who once met a great challenge in his career. Once, his company faced a major opportunity for cooperation, but the terms of this deal were not entirely fair. Many people advised him to use the chance to profit for himself, even at the possible expense of the other party’s interests. Yet Li Ming insisted on devising good and decided to make a fair deal with the other side, holding to honesty and integrity during the negotiations. In the end, although the cooperation turned out harder than expected, he not only won the other party’s trust but also gained more stable and long-term opportunities for the company.

Li Ming’s experience tells us that when we choose to devise good and act righteously, even if the process is hard, we will in the end receive God’s lovingkindness and truth, and God will open a way for us and bring unexpected blessings.

Dear family, let us remember that when we devise good and act righteously, God’s lovingkindness and truth will accompany us and never leave. May we each day take doing good and honesty as our foundation and experience God’s abundant love and blessing.
a: A Day of Choosing Good Deeds
Today, take the initiative to do three good deeds, whether helping a stranger, cooking a meal for your family, or apologizing first, and make doing good part of your daily life.
Fair Dealing Challenge
In daily life, whether trading with a merchant or a friend, choose fairness and honesty, and ask God’s blessing in your heart. He will surely give you lovingkindness and truth.
Thankfulness for Good Deeds

Write down the good deeds you have done in the past week and thank God for the opportunities to do good. Share these good deeds with those around you, bearing witness to God’s lovingkindness and truth.
Share a Story of Faithfulness
Share with family or friends a story of when you experienced God’s faithfulness and lovingkindness, and encourage them also to devise good and act righteously and to experience God’s blessing.
Meditation and Prayer
Each day, spend time meditating on today’s verse and pray that God will help you keep a heart that devises good and acts righteously, so that your life reflects God’s lovingkindness and truth.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us lovingkindness and truth and for leading us to do good in our lives. Help us to choose uprightness and righteousness, so that our lives are full of Your lovingkindness and blessing. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you choose to do good and devise good in every day of your life, and so receive God’s lovingkindness and truth, filling your life with God’s blessing and peace. Amen!

v: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
b: This verse expresses the psalmist’s longing for God: that God’s lovingkindness would fill our lives early and let us rejoice and be glad all our days. Lovingkindness is a precious grace God gives us, bringing immeasurable joy and peace. Whatever our circumstances, once we have experienced God’s lovingkindness, our souls can be satisfied.

It is like a bowl of steaming hot soup after a long hunger, which makes a person feel warm and satisfied. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is nourishment for our souls. When we long for His love, His lovingkindness warms our hearts like this soup and gives us the strength of joy.

There was a sister named Zhang Yun who for a time went through a great emotional crisis and felt her life lacked direction and meaning. She began to depend more on God and brought her heart’s concerns before Him. Once, in prayer, she cried out to God, longing for His lovingkindness to enter her life and let her find peace and joy again. A few days later she began to feel God’s love flowing in her heart, and each day she could sense His company and care, which filled her soul with a peace and joy she had never known. Her life was changed by God’s lovingkindness, and she no longer felt lonely and lost but was filled with joy and gratitude.

Zhang Yun’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is the source of satisfaction and joy for a whole lifetime. When we are willing to open our hearts and let His love fill them, we can experience His joy and become a blessing to those around us.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is a precious gift for our whole life. May we each day be satisfied with God’s lovingkindness and answer His love with a heart that shouts for joy.
a: Daily Writing of Thanks
Each day, write down three things that make you feel God’s lovingkindness, and give thanks for how His love flows through your life, filling your soul.
Prayer Full of Lovingkindness
Take time to pray, asking God’s lovingkindness to fill your heart, and pray for relatives and friends around you, that they too may experience God’s lovingkindness.
Sharing Lovingkindness

Share with those around you the lovingkindness of God that you have sensed lately, whether perseverance in difficulty or God’s faithfulness in life, letting lovingkindness be passed on through your mouth.
Joyful Activity
Plan a day to do something that makes you happy and experience God’s joy and lovingkindness in it, whether a walk, music, or time with friends, letting God’s love surround it.
Time to Reflect on Lovingkindness

Each day, quiet yourself to reflect on how God watches over you with His lovingkindness, and record these experiences. Let these reflections be a reminder so that God’s love becomes a daily source of strength.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for surrounding us with eternal lovingkindness, so that we can experience Your love in every day of our lives. Help us to bring Your love to others and let Your lovingkindness fill our hearts. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God’s lovingkindness fill your heart early, so that all your days you walk in His joy and satisfaction. Amen!

v: Sow to yourselves in righteousness. Reap according to kindness.
b: This verse lets us see that God’s grace and lovingkindness are not only gifts He gives us but also the result of something we must cultivate. Just as a farmer expects a harvest after sowing, our conduct, choices, and attitudes directly affect the love and blessing we reap. When we choose to practice righteousness and scatter the seeds of righteousness in daily life, in God’s time we will reap His lovingkindness.

It is like a gardener who diligently plants every seed and tends it with care, waiting for it to grow, blossom, and bear fruit as the seasons turn. In the same way, each of our choices and each act of giving is meant to scatter seeds of righteousness and love, and in the end we will reap endless lovingkindness from God.

There was a sister named Yang Ying who had been through much pain and many challenges in her life. Because of some misunderstandings she had fallen out with someone, and her heart had always carried dissatisfaction and anger. Later she began to realize that these emotions brought her no benefit but only made her life heavier. She decided to change, began to sow righteousness for herself, learned to forgive and pray for others, and chose to respond to difficulties with love and kindness. Slowly she found that the people around her also began to show her more care and support, and her life was filled with God’s lovingkindness and blessing. Her life began to have new meaning and joy, and she knew that all this was because she was willing to sow righteousness and had reaped God’s lovingkindness.

Ying’s experience reminds us that sowing righteousness is not an overnight process. It takes patience and determination, but in the end we will reap God’s endless lovingkindness and blessing. When we choose to act according to God’s heart, we will experience His abundant grace in our lives.

Dear family, let us remember that sowing righteousness is the responsibility of every Christian, and such a choice brings God’s lovingkindness and blessing. May we walk in His righteousness each day and reap His endless lovingkindness.
a: Forgiveness and Reconciliation
Choose to forgive someone who has hurt you and pray for them, letting love and forgiveness take root and sprout in your heart.
Challenge to Act Righteously
Each day, do one righteous thing, whether helping someone in need or standing up to speak for the truth, letting righteousness become part of your life.
Notebook of Thanks
Each day, write down three loves and blessings you have reaped because you chose righteousness, and witness to God’s grace in your journal.
Acts of Love
Take the initiative to help the vulnerable or those in difficulty around you, and let God’s love flow around you.
Caring for the Public Good
Take part in local public-good activities, whether volunteering, giving, or supporting movements for social justice, and let acts of love be passed on in society.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us to sow righteousness and to reap lovingkindness at the time You have prepared. Help us each day to live out righteousness and acts of love, and to be satisfied by Your lovingkindness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sow righteousness in every choice, and reap from God His abundant lovingkindness and blessing. Amen!

t: Lovingkindness for Those Who Fear Him
v: But the loving kindness of Yahweh is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,
b: This verse lets us see that God’s lovingkindness is eternal and comes especially upon those who fear Him. To fear God is not only to worship and obey Him but also to respect and respond to His righteousness and lovingkindness. When we fear God, His lovingkindness flows into our lives like a steady power and continues on to our descendants.

It is like the morning dew that moistens every blade of grass. When the blades grow toward the sun, they can absorb nourishment from the earth. In the same way, when we fear God and rely on Him, our lives are nourished by His lovingkindness, and we pass this love on to the next generation.

There was a sister named Li Yijun whose family had once faced many challenges because of financial difficulty. She and her husband had lost confidence in life, and the pressure of money strained their relationship, so that they even wondered whether God would show them grace. Yet Yijun decided to bring faith into her home, praying every day with her husband and seeking God’s guidance. She often reminded herself and her husband that, whatever the situation, they should fear God and keep their faith. Gradually their family began to see God’s hand at work, their finances slowly improved, and the relationship between husband and wife grew closer. Yijun knew that all of this was lovingkindness God had given because she and her family feared Him.

Yijun’s testimony tells us that when we fear God, His lovingkindness works in our lives and brings stability and blessing. God’s lovingkindness can not only change our lives but also influence our next generation, letting His righteousness continue in our families.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness belongs to those who fear Him. When we fear God and obey Him, His love will fill our lives and continue to our descendants, bringing abundant blessing.
a: Establish Family Prayer Time
Set a fixed time each day to pray with your family, focusing on reverence for God and giving thanks for His lovingkindness and righteousness.
Acts of Fearing God
In daily life, choose to obey God’s word, and show behavior that fears God, whether at work, at home, or in social settings.
Pray for the Next Generation
Pray for your children or future descendants, asking God to give His lovingkindness and righteousness, and that they may fear God all their lives.
Share Testimonies
Share with those around you the lovingkindness and righteousness God has shown in your life, encouraging them also to fear God and experience His grace.
Write a Gratitude Journal
Each day, record the lovingkindness of God that you have experienced, and write down every good thing God has done for you in your life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your endless lovingkindness and righteousness. Every blessing You give us is more than we ask or think. Help us to fear You all our lives, to live out the life You intend, and to extend Your love to our descendants. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you draw near to God with a heart of reverence every day, and gain a rich life in His endless lovingkindness. Amen!

v: Oh that men would praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is worthy of our praise, and that the wonders He does are even more a reason for our thanks and praise. God’s lovingkindness is not merely a feeling; it is shown in every experience of our lives. Whether in small daily blessings or in mighty deliverance, God’s lovingkindness is in them.

It is like an artist who creates a brilliant painting, with every stroke bearing his love and effort. When we see the painting, we not only admire its beauty but should also praise the artist’s skill and thought. In the same way, when we experience God’s wonders and lovingkindness, we should praise His greatness and thank Him for all He has done for us.

There was a sister named Li Chenxi whose story is a true testimony to God’s lovingkindness. In her youth Chenxi suffered a serious illness, and the doctors told her that the chance of treatment was slim and her quality of life would be greatly reduced. At that time she and her family fell into deep despair. Yet Chenxi chose to commit everything to God, and she kept praying on her sickbed, seeking God’s healing. A few months later she was miraculously restored to health. The doctors too were amazed at the result and said it was a medical miracle. Chenxi gave thanks for God’s lovingkindness and shared this experience with everyone around her, giving the praise to God.

Chenxi’s testimony tells us that when God does wonders, we should not only give thanks but also proclaim His lovingkindness and wonders, so that more people can see God’s greatness and lovingkindness.

Dear family, let us remember that we can experience God’s lovingkindness every day, and every wonder He does is worthy of our praising His name aloud. When we experience His grace in our lives, we should not only give thanks but also share His love and blessing with others, so that more people, through God’s wonders and lovingkindness, come into His presence.
a: Sharing Testimonies of Lovingkindness
Each day, write down at least one wonder God has done in your life, big or small, and share it with those around you, so that God’s love spreads among the people near you.
Thankful Prayer Journal
Start a thankful prayer journal, write down each day the lovingkindness of God that you have sensed, and offer thanks for these blessings.
A Time of Praise Music
Choose a day to play your favorite songs of praise, focus on God’s lovingkindness, and praise His wonders and grace.
Plan of Lovingkindness in Action
Take the initiative to help those in need, whether with material help or emotional support, and let God’s love expand around you.
Family Thanksgiving Dinner
Set up a thanksgiving dinner time with your family, share the wonders God has done in your family, and praise His lovingkindness together.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your endless lovingkindness and the wonders You have done. Help us always to remember Your lovingkindness and, in each day’s life, to share Your wonders and blessings with those around us. May our lives be full of praise, so that more people come to know You because of Your wonders. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s lovingkindness in every day of your life, and may your heart be filled with praise and thanks because of the wonders He has done. Amen!

t: Glory to Your Name for Your Lovingkindness
v: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
b: This verse reminds us that all glory should be given to God, especially for His lovingkindness and truth. When we see God’s grace revealed in our lives, and when we experience His blessing and lovingkindness, we should be thankful and give all the glory to Him. In good times and in bad, our lives should reflect God’s lovingkindness and lift up His name.

It is like a painter who creates a beautiful painting. However exquisite the painting, the honor belongs to the painter, not to the painting itself. When our lives are filled with God’s lovingkindness and grace, our every action and every word should be praise and thanks to God.

There was a sister named Li Huiting whose story truly demonstrates the truth of this verse. Huiting grew up in the faith and went through her family’s financial difficulties and health challenges. In these difficulties God’s lovingkindness was with her, and she was often able to sense God’s comfort and help in hardship. Once, while she was serving at church, she found that she had suddenly been given a chance at promotion. It was not only her own effort but God’s blessing and grace. She did not credit it all to herself but at once gave the glory to God, telling those around her that all this was because of God’s lovingkindness and truth.
Huiting’s experience tells us that God’s blessing and lovingkindness often appear in our lives, and that we should see these blessings as the overflow of God’s grace and give the glory to Him.

Dear family, let us remember that everything we have, material or spiritual, is God’s grace. Our lives should reflect His lovingkindness and truth, and in every day of our lives we should give the glory to Him.
a: Journal of Glory to God
Each day, write down specific events in which God has shown lovingkindness and truth in your life, thank Him for His grace, and give all the glory to Him.
Sharing Testimonies of Thanks
Share with family or friends the lovingkindness of God that you have experienced, so that they too see God’s greatness, and give the glory to God together.
A Time of Worship and Praise
Arrange a time to worship God with undivided attention, whether in singing, prayer, or Bible reading, giving all the glory to God.
Plan of Lovingkindness in Action
Take the initiative to help someone in need, putting God’s lovingkindness into practice so that they feel God’s love and care.
Family Prayer Time
Give thanks with your family for God’s lovingkindness and truth, and ask God to help us live out His love in daily life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your boundless lovingkindness and truth. Your grace is revealed in our lives every day. Help us to keep giving glory to You in our lives, so that our lives become a witness to Your lovingkindness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, in every day of your life, give all the glory to God because of His lovingkindness and truth, and live with a thankful and reverent heart. Amen!

v: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
b: This verse expresses the psalmist’s longing for God’s lovingkindness and shows his reliance on God’s guidance. He hopes to hear God’s words of lovingkindness in the early morning, because that is his strength and guidance for each day. This is not only the psalmist’s heart cry but also the longing of each of us who believe: at the start of every day, to seek God’s voice, letting His lovingkindness fill our hearts and guide us on the right path.

It is like the first ray of morning sunshine, warm and bright, driving away the gloom of the night and bringing hope for the new day. In the same way, God’s words of lovingkindness are like this morning light, warming our hearts so that we can face each day’s challenges with confidence. When we rely on His lovingkindness and guidance, we can walk boldly on the path He has prepared for us.

There was a sister named Zhang Wenhui who for a time faced a major life decision, whether to change jobs. She felt deeply lost and did not know how to choose. Every morning she began to dedicate herself to God and spend time listening to His voice in quiet. One early morning, as she was reading the Bible, God’s word lit up her heart like the morning light, and she sensed God’s lovingkindness and guidance, which gave her a peaceful assurance. In the end she chose to step out of her comfort zone and accept a new challenge, and this decision also brought a breakthrough in her career.

Wenhui’s testimony reminds us that God’s lovingkindness is the strength we must rely on every day. When we listen to His word in the early morning, He will guide us on the right path and give us the wisdom and courage we need.

Dear family, let us remember that the start of every day can find comfort and guidance in God’s lovingkindness. However many challenges there are in life, God’s word always points a bright direction for our lives and gives us strength to walk.
a: Quiet Time in the Morning
Set aside a quiet time each morning to talk with God attentively, read the Bible or meditate on His word, and ask God to guide your path for the day.
Prayer Card of Lovingkindness
Write down a passage of Scripture in which you sensed God’s lovingkindness, and read it aloud each morning, letting these words be your strength for the whole day.
Daily Listening
Whenever you face a choice or difficulty, stop and pray silently, listen to God’s voice, and let His words of lovingkindness guide your conduct.
Share Lovingkindness
Share with family or friends the insight or lovingkindness of God you received in the early morning, letting God’s word be a blessing to one another.
Steps of Faith
With every step, thank God for His guidance, and receive His lovingkindness and guidance in faith, walking on the path He has prepared.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us lovingkindness and wisdom every day, guiding us to walk in Your way. Help us to listen to Your voice each day and to act according to Your word. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hear God’s words of lovingkindness every early morning, and, under His guidance, walk the good path He has prepared for you. Amen!

v: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
b: This verse reminds us that, as God’s children, we are called to imitate His conduct, especially His lovingkindness. God’s lovingkindness is for us not only the giving of grace but also the showing of an example. His lovingkindness is found not only in His words but also in His actions: He received us with unconditional love and gives guidance for our lives with mercy and kindness.

It is like parents who teach their children with selfless love and, by their every word and deed, show them how to express love and care. Children usually imitate their parents’ behavior, because in their parents’ love they find security and strength. God, as our Heavenly Father, also uses His lovingkindness to teach us how to love others, and He wants us to pass this love on.

There was a sister named Li Li who once faced a problem at work. Her coworker often framed her and put her in difficulty at work. At first Li’s heart was full of resentment, and she wanted to take revenge on her coworker. But as she sought God’s help in prayer, God reminded her that He treated her with unconditional love and mercy. So Li decided to imitate God, put down the anger in her heart, and choose to forgive those who had treated her unfairly. As a result, her conduct not only changed her but also changed the coworkers around her, and even led those who had hurt her to reflect on their own behavior and apologize to her.

Li’s experience tells us that when we imitate God’s lovingkindness, our lives are not only transformed but also influence others. God’s lovingkindness gives us the strength to forgive, to accept, and to love those who are unkind to us. This is the pattern of life He wants each of His children to live out.

Dear family, let us remember that we are beloved children, and God’s lovingkindness has taken deep root in our lives. May we live out this love every day, imitate God, and show His love to those around us.
a: Forgiving in Lovingkindness
Think back on people who have offended you in the past, forgive them in your heart on your own initiative, and pray a blessing over them.
Pass On Lovingkindness
At home or at work, take the initiative to show care and display God’s lovingkindness to others, whether through words of encouragement or practical help.
Journal of Lovingkindness
Each day, record the moments when you sensed God’s lovingkindness, and meditate in your heart on how to live out this lovingkindness.
Caring for Others
Help friends or family in need through practical action, pray for them, and bring God’s love into their lives.
Bible Meditation
Read a passage each day about God’s lovingkindness and meditate on how to practice God’s lovingkindness in your life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us unconditional lovingkindness and for calling us to imitate Your love. Help us, in each day’s life, to live out Your love and share it with those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you walk in God’s lovingkindness every day, imitate His love, and let this love be the strength and testimony of your life. Amen!

v: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
b: This verse reminds us that God’s lovingkindness does not appear at only one moment but is revealed at the time God chooses, and for the sake of our salvation. This is not only a look back at the past but also a look ahead to the future: God’s kindness and lovingkindness are fully revealed in the saving work of Jesus Christ and continue to be shown in our lives.

God’s lovingkindness has its moments of appearing in history, like the first light of dawn breaking out of the darkness and bringing hope and light. When we look back on the birth, suffering, and resurrection of Jesus Christ, we see how God’s heart of love for mankind was revealed through this series of historical events. This lovingkindness is not only grace from the past but also the endless grace we experience now.

It is like spring rain, which comes suddenly but is full of nourishment, bringing the revival of life and a rich harvest. God’s lovingkindness often appears quietly in our lives, but when we are truly willing to open our hearts and receive His love, we find that He is at work in our every day, leading us toward new hope and life.

There was a sister named Yang Wenxia who in her youth had been deep in confusion and perplexity, always feeling she could not escape her predicament. When her life had sunk to a low point, she began to attend church activities and heard God’s word there. At that very moment she sensed God’s lovingkindness, which, like candlelight, lit up her heart. She began to feel God’s grace and mercy, which not only helped her out of the difficulties in her life but also brought comfort and calm deep in her soul. Looking back on the past, she found that each stretch of suffering and challenge was in fact a revealing of God’s lovingkindness, by which He brought her out of the darkness and into new life.

Wenxia’s testimony tells us that God’s lovingkindness is not far from us but appears when we need it most, giving us endless hope and strength. Even if we cannot feel His presence in hardship, when we turn to Him, His love will water our lives like a spring.

Dear family, let us remember that God’s lovingkindness is everywhere. At every point in time and every stage of life, there are moments when He shows His lovingkindness. Let us live in His love and let His lovingkindness be our strength every day.
a: Review of Lovingkindness
Each day, spend some time looking back on the moments when God showed lovingkindness in your life, and thank Him.
Sharing Stories of Lovingkindness
Share with family or friends a testimony of how God has shown lovingkindness in your life, so that they too sense God’s grace.
Selfless Giving
Find someone who needs help, whether in spirit or in material things, reach out a hand on your own initiative, and put God’s love into concrete practice.
Reflection on Lovingkindness
Write down the moments of the day in which you experienced God’s lovingkindness, and think about how He is shaping more love in your heart.
Prayer of Thanks
Each day in prayer, thank God for His lovingkindness and ask Him to show more grace and guidance in your life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing endless lovingkindness in our lives. Help us to be keenly aware of Your love at every moment and to pass this love on to those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience the appearing of God’s lovingkindness every day, and, in good times or bad, sense His grace and be renewed and made joyful in this lovingkindness. Amen!

v: Behold, what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
b: This verse reminds us how wonderful and selfless the love is that God has given us, making us not only His creation but His children. This love gives us an identity that belongs to God and gives us incomparable worth. The sacrifice of Jesus Christ lets us build the closest relationship with God and become precious children at His heart. This is not only grace we have received but also the identity and testimony we can live out in the world.

This love is beyond the understanding and acceptance of the world, just as the verse says, “For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.” Such love does not depend on outward conditions but is God’s unconditional love and acceptance of us. It is based not on any achievement or background but on God’s own heart. He is willing to receive us as His children and give us eternal life.

It is like parents who, however their child behaves, are always willing to open their arms and embrace him, accepting all his faults and shortcomings. God’s love is like such a parent’s heart. He does not require us to be perfect but is willing to restore us with His great love, letting us experience His unconditional acceptance and love.

There was a sister named Li Wen who had gone through many setbacks and failures in life and even felt unworthy of God’s love. She often felt she was not good enough and was always afraid of God’s acceptance. Then one day, as she was reading the Bible, this verse touched her deeply, and she suddenly understood that God’s love is unconditional and had long since been given to her, making her His child. From then on Li Wen no longer doubted her own worth. She began to believe she was a child loved by God and, with this love as her foundation, faced every challenge with courage. Her life became stronger because of this love, and she became a blessing to many people in the church.

Li Wen’s story tells us that when we know and accept this “what manner of love” God has given us, our lives will be turned around, from doubt to faith, from hopelessness to hope. This love changes not only our identity but also our future.
