Dear family, let us remember that we are God’s children, and this lovingkindness is unconditional and a precious gift He has given us. May we each day take this love as our foundation and live a life that trusts God firmly and lives out His will.
a: Confirm Your Identity as a Child
Spend some time quietly before God, come to know and receive anew the identity as His child that He has given you, and thank Him for the unconditional love He has given.
Sharing Lovingkindness
Take the initiative to share with friends, family, or coworkers your experience of God’s lovingkindness, so that they too can sense this love.
Testimony of Lovingkindness
Express God’s love through action, offering practical support to people in need, whether material aid or spiritual encouragement.
Intimate Prayer Time
Build a daily time of intimate prayer with God, letting His love fill your heart deeply and sense His presence and leading.
Journal of Thanks for Lovingkindness
Each day, record at least one thing in which you experienced God’s love, and look back on these things one by one, giving Him thanks.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us such lovingkindness that we have become Your children. Help us to sense this love every day and to pass it on to those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience the boundless lovingkindness God has given you every day, and let this love be the strength and hope of your life. Amen!

v: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
b: This verse conveys God’s good blessing for us. When we read these words, we should deeply sense God’s love and care for each one of us. He wants us not only to experience His lovingkindness but also to have that lovingkindness “multiplied” to us. This means that God’s love is limitless and ever increasing, and always full of abundant and endless grace.

This blessing is not a simple prayer but God’s deep intention for His people. God’s lovingkindness is neither limited nor occasional, but flows without ceasing and often comes into our lives in abundance. When we truly rely on Him, He lets us continually experience this unconditional, endless lovingkindness.

It is like a river, which not only has a source but also keeps flowing downstream, bringing the nourishment of water. In the same way, God’s lovingkindness is like this ever-flowing river, drawing us toward a better future and bringing nourishment to the soul and fullness to life.

There was a sister named Zhou Yun who had gone through many challenges and difficulties in life and had once felt herself sinking into deep loneliness and helplessness. Yet in her darkest hour she began to pray every day, asking God to multiply His mercy, peace, and lovingkindness to her. As time went by, Zhou Yun was surprised to find that God’s love was not only continually increasing in her life, but that whenever she bowed her head in prayer in difficulty, she could always feel a warm strength from God helping her stand again. Her soul was not only comforted, but the many challenges in her life also found strength in God’s love.

Zhou Yun’s testimony helps us understand that when we call on God’s mercy, peace, and lovingkindness, God does not hold back His blessing but lets these blessings flow to us continually, bringing us joy and peace that go beyond our circumstances.

Dear family, today let us once again affirm this blessing from God and believe that, whatever our situation, God’s mercy, peace, and lovingkindness will come into our lives in more and more ways. Let our hearts no longer doubt or fear, because we know that God’s love is multiplied to us and never stops.
a: Daily Review of Lovingkindness
Each day, write down three moments in which you sensed God’s lovingkindness, whether through scenes of nature, others’ blessings, or inner peace.
Challenge of Lovingkindness in Action
Take the initiative to do something that lets others sense God’s lovingkindness. It could be helping someone in need or passing on words of encouragement to those around you.
Prayer for Peace
Spend time quietly praying to God, asking His peace and lovingkindness to come upon your soul, and express your thanks to Him.
Connection of Love
Take the initiative to share with family or friends how God has given lovingkindness and mercy in your life, and pray together, sensing the resonance of God’s love.
Passing On a Blessing
Each day, pass a blessing to someone you know, saying “May God’s lovingkindness be with you” or similar words, so that they too can sense God’s blessing.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us endless lovingkindness and letting us experience Your grace every day. Help us to share this lovingkindness with those around us, letting Your love flow like a flood and bring more joy and peace to this world. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God’s mercy, peace, and lovingkindness be multiplied to you, and be your strength and joy in your daily life. Amen!
